policy.latest: The newest accepted regular product increment is draft=false, prerelease=false and must resolve from GitHub /releases/latest after publication.

claimEvidence.claim: v0.2.0-poc.20260823.6 is the current regular Latest release for the fail-closed continuity, reversible migration-edge and authority-free staging contract increment.
nonClaims: A tag or draft alone is not public release evidence.
Calendar cadence does not determine release status.

claimEvidence.claim: PANSPHAIRA ships digest-bound Verification Fabric contracts, a Shadow Evidence-DAG planner, closed executable adaptive-evidence gates, and a separate operator-invoked default-off controller that preserves honest delivery state.
claimEvidence.userValue: Maintainers get auditable proportional verification and restart-safe local coordination; uncertainty still falls back to full validation and external waits never become false success.

functionalProof.result: PASS: existing Verification Fabric proofs remain green; adaptive gates pass 25/25 and the default-off controller passes 9/9 including happy, negative, fault, restart, retry saturation and a bounded 20-run soak.

safetyProof.result: PASS: central, unmapped, unsafe, ambiguous, invalid, cyclic, drifting, stale, forged, flaky, scope-shrunk, collision and partial-write inputs over-select, enter ATTENTION/WAITING_EXTERNAL or fail closed; none become false success.

nonClaims: Local deterministic proof; volatile Shadow activation progress remains tracked in issue #34, the controller remains default-off and no scheduler is included. No authoritative adaptive test-depth reduction, default activation, external completion truth, representative long-duration or multi-host evidence, production readiness, security certification or external authority is proven.
